scope: Source review of the anyGeometry/geoCl construction route and explicit callers; no whole-project build or exported compiled declaration dependency graph.

findings.summary: anyGeometry is constant True; geoOf demands a positive witness, IsGeoOf and HasTrueSurf. OAt also demands LamAre, so OAt anyGeometry is not definitionally True.
GeoCl is an inductive closure with base and step. geoCl anyGeometry is always inhabitable via base trivial; recursive step is not a self-justifying cyclic proof and does not restore geoOf.

The current final source route passes geoCl anyGeometry, but separately passes a CovolumeBoundOfX proof. Its stated conclusion contains an eventual L3 bound; its actual supplier is topCovolSlim2_use_alt_alt, followed by independent-looking source lemmas. Those deep lemmas have not all been semantically re-audited.

Degenerate models with True predicates, zero volumes/degrees and zero iMj are genuinely constructed. divEx_of_ox ignores its three literature-premise arguments and uses a previously constructed weak-model existence theorem; this is not by itself circular reasoning. Do not translate it as proof that a strong geoOf realisation was established.
